# Acme Example Co: Support note (FAKE FIXTURE)

This is a made-up document used only to test DevOCD.

- Support tickets arrive in the shared inbox and are triaged each morning.
- A bug report needs steps to reproduce, the app version and one example account id.
- Never ask a customer for a password; ask for a screenshot of the error instead.
- Escalate to engineering through the "support-escalation" channel with the ticket link.
